title: Xerox Opens 2026 Global Partner Summit with Record Attendance and Expanded Partner Opportunities
summary: Xerox Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: XRX) today welcomed more than 500 channel partners representing more than 70 countries to its 2026 Global Partner Summit to explore new opportunities created by the company's expanded portfolio, capabilities and global...
body_markdown:
**NASHVILLE** —


[Xerox Holdings Corporation](https://www.xerox.com/) (NASDAQ: XRX) today welcomed more than 500 channel partners representing more than 70 countries to its 2026 Global Partner Summit to explore new opportunities created by the company's expanded portfolio, capabilities and global reach.


“Over the past few years, we've taken significant steps to strengthen Xerox and broaden what we can deliver for customers. Now the opportunity is to put those advantages to work with our partners: expanding client relationships, reaching new buyers and accelerating profitable growth,” said Jacques-Edouard Gueden, chief revenue officer at Xerox. “Our partners are critical to bringing those capabilities to market, and this summit is about giving them more ways to compete and win.”


During the Summit, Xerox is showcasing how its expanded portfolio, service and technology capabilities, global reach and go-to-market resources are giving partners more ways to address evolving client needs, strengthen existing relationships and pursue new business. The event features executive discussions, product demonstrations, networking opportunities and partner-led sessions focused on growth and market expansion, and will also include a keynote address from Ovette Sampson, founder of Right AI.


As one example of the expanded portfolio and capabilities available to partners, Xerox introduced the Xerox® 7 M-Series and 8 M-Series black-and-white A4 printers and MFPs, along with enhancements to Xerox® Print and Scan Experience and the Xerox® Easy Assist mobile app.


Designed with security, productivity and sustainability in mind, the new devices feature advanced security capabilities, faster scanning speeds, improved reliability and support for a broad range of specialty applications.


Together with Xerox Print and Scan Experience and Xerox Easy Assist, the portfolio helps organizations simplify document-intensive processes, improve productivity, and create a more connected workplace experience.


Regional rollout of the Xerox 7 M-Series and 8 M-Series begins Oct. 27. Xerox Print and Scan Experience and Xerox Easy Assist are available now.


To learn more about the Xerox Global Partner Program and the full Xerox portfolio, visitwww.xerox.com .


**About Xerox Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: XRX)**


Xerox is a global technology company with more than 120 years of innovation leadership. We design, manufacture, deliver, and support print, IT, and digital services for nearly 200,000 clients worldwide. Our integrated, AI-powered portfolio includes managed and production print, document management, workflow automation, cybersecurity, cloud managed services, IT infrastructure and collaboration technology. Serving clients from growing SMBs to 90 percent of the Fortune 500, Xerox supports leading healthcare, government, financial services, education, legal, retail and commercial organizations. Through direct sales and a global network of channel partners, we deliver the technology, expertise, and support organizations need to operate efficiently, securely and at scale.
